rachel-finance: Quick one 62 Covalent Bios (private) had a midterm rollback from Enterprise to Core effective 2026-09-11. We billed full year platform fee on INV-112334. Customer wants a single settlement number.

omar-billing: Which SOW and reseller chain? Need to run proration and check commissions.

rachel-finance: SOW CB-3D. No reseller in contract, direct deal. Effective 2026-09-11. Customer prefers credit memo applied to renewal.

billing-bot: Metering export: /exports/covalent_220999_batch.csv

billing-bot: CSV snippet:
```
2026-08-01,platform_fee,1,78000
2026-08-01,onprem_vcpu_hours,4700,0
2026-09-11,change_event,1,0
```

jess-account: Numbers: Enterprise annual = $78,000. Core = $46,800. Delta = $31,200. Remaining months from 2026-09-11 to 2027-01-01 ~ 3.67 months => factor 0.3058. Prorated credit = 31,200 * 0.3058 = $9,543. Round per customer ask to $9,500.

diego-cs: Customer said theyll accept $9.5k if we mark "final settlement" on the memo and provide PDF now. They need it for their Q3 audit.

mina-legal: We'll add release language: "This credit memo constitutes full and final settlement of platform fee differences arising from the 2026-09-11 support tier rollback under SOW CB-3D." Need finance lead sign-off.

omar-billing: Creating credit memo CM-220999-01 for $9,500, status=Ready. Since no reseller, no commission issue. Tagging AR to post.

ceo-cfo-bot: Auto-check: revenue impact < $10k, posting allowed under delegated authority.

omar-billing: Posted CM-220999-01 to AR, PDF attached, Collections notified. jess-account please send to Covalent AP.

jess-account: Sending now. Email body: "Attached: Credit Memo CM-220999-01 — Final settlement of platform fee differential (SOW CB-3D)." Sent to ap@covalentbio.com, AP confirmed receipt.

rachel-finance: Filing memo under SOW CB-3D and FO ticket FO-3499. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
